    previous = list(range(len(target) + 1))
    for i, s in enumerate(source, start=1):

import heapq
from collections import defaultdict


def topo_order(nodes, edges):
    successors = defaultdict(list)
    indegree = {}
    for before, after in edges:
        successors[before].append(after)
        indegree.setdefault(before, 0)
        indegree[after] = indegree.get(after, 0) + 1

    ready = [node for node, degree in indegree.items() if degree == 0]
    heapq.heapify(ready)
    order = []
    while ready:
        node = heapq.heappop(ready)
        order.append(node)
        for after in successors[node]:
            indegree[after] -= 1
            if indegree[after] == 0:
                heapq.heappush(ready, after)

    if len(order) != len(indegree):
        raise ValueError("graph has a cycle")
    return order
```

import re

PATTERN = re.compile(r"P(?:([0-9]+)D)?(?:T(?=[0-9])(?:([0-9]+)H)?(?:([0-9]+)M)?(?:([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]{1,3}))?S)?)?")


def duration_ms(text):
    match = PATTERN.fullmatch(text)
    if not match or not any(match.groups()):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid duration: {text!r}")
    days, hours, minutes, seconds, millis = (int(value) if value else 0 for value in match.groups())
    return ((days * 24 + hours) * 60 + minutes) * 60_000 + seconds * 1000 + millis
```

import re

_HEADER = re.compile(r"\[[ \t]*(.*?)[ \t]*\]")
_ENTRY = re.compile(r"([^=]*?)[ \t]*=[ \t]*(.*)")


def parse_ini(text):
    result = {}
    section = ""
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        line = line.strip(" \t")
        if line == "" or line.startswith((";", "#")):
            continue
        if line.startswith("["):
            header = _HEADER.fullmatch(line)
            if header is None or header.group(1) == "":
                raise ValueError(f"bad section header: {line!r}")
            section = header.group(1)
            result.setdefault(section, {})
            continue
        entry = _ENTRY.fullmatch(line)
        if entry is None or entry.group(1) == "":
            raise ValueError(f"not a key = value line: {line!r}")
        result.setdefault(section, {})[entry.group(1)] = entry.group(2)
    return result
```

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

_FORMAT = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?:Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})")


def to_utc(text):
    if not _FORMAT.fullmatch(text):
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported date-time: {text!r}")
    zone = text[19:]
    if zone not in ("Z", "-00:00") and (int(zone[1:3]) > 23 or int(zone[4:6]) > 59):
        raise ValueError(f"bad offset: {text!r}")
    try:
        local = datetime.strptime(text[:19] + ("+0000" if zone == "Z" else zone.replace(":", "")), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
        utc = local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    except (ValueError, OverflowError) as error:
        raise ValueError(f"no such instant: {text!r}") from error
    return f"{utc.year:04d}-{utc.month:02d}-{utc.day:02d}T{utc.hour:02d}:{utc.minute:02d}:{utc.second:02d}Z"
```

import re
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal, localcontext

_NUMBER = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?")


def round_half_even(text, places):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not _NUMBER.fullmatch(text):
        raise ValueError(f"not a decimal number: {text!r}")
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        rounded = Decimal(text).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-places), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    if rounded.is_zero():

    return format(rounded, "f")
